verses.1: For Ethan, this is a public affair.
verses.2: The mercy of the LORD will be everlasting; I will praise it day after day. I will proclaim your truth with my lips.
verses.3: For I have said, “永遠 will there be kindness in heaven; your truth will be established in them.”
verses.4: I have made a covenant with my chosen one; I will praise David, my servant.
verses.5: “I will prepare your seed for ever, and I will plant them as pillars for your throne.”
verses.6: May the heavens rejoice, O LORD! May your faithfulness be known in the midst of the holy ones.
verses.7: For who among the gods can truly resemble Jehovah? Who can be like Jehovah in His creations?
verses.8: He is worthy of great reverence and awe in all his sacred acts and wonders.
verses.9: Yehova, God of the armies, how can you be safe from me? Your truth is everywhere around you.
verses.10: You rule over the waves of the sea with your strength. You will be praised by all people.
verses.11: You have become a despicable monster in the midst of your own people. Your enemies have been destroyed.
verses.12: To you, the heavens; and to you, the earth. You created them both.
verses.13: You created them, Zaphon and Yamin. They became worthless and useless in your eyes. May they be destroyed by your name.
verses.14: May you be blessed with greatness; may your hand be strong, and may your right hand be victorious.
verses.15: Justice and righteousness will stand on your throne. Mercy and truth will face your face.
verses.16: As for those who know the Lord’s suffering, they will walk in the light of your face.
verses.17: In your name, they will be known every day; and in your righteousness, they will be blessed.
verses.18: For you are worthy of praise, and in your kindness, you have blessed us.
verses.19: For Jehovah is our defense, and Israel is our king.
verses.20: Then you spoke in prophecy to your saints, and said, “I have sent help for those who are in need. I have chosen a group from among the people to assist them.”
verses.21: I found David, my servant, in my holy temple, where he was being sacrificed.
verses.22: May my hands be strong with him, and may my words strengthen him.
verses.23: He shall not be harmed or offended. And the son of a prostitute shall not respond to him.
verses.24: And I will remove from him his sorrows and his troubles.
verses.25: And my mercy and grace will be with him; and in my presence, his light will shine.
verses.26: And I placed his hand in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.
verses.27: He will call me “Father.” You are my Lord, and you are my Savior.
verses.28: I also set him on high among the kings of the earth.
verses.29: I will always keep His kindness and my covenant with Him.
verses.30: And I have set its seed and its throne as forever, from the days of ancient times.
verses.31: If they abandon My laws and My judgments, then they shall not go away.
verses.32: If my laws are broken, and my commandments are not obeyed.
verses.33: And I punished them for their sins and their evil deeds.
verses.34: And my grace will not be with him, and I will not betray my own truth.
verses.35: I will not break my covenant. Nor will I change my words.
verses.36: One of them was named Lodovid Akzib.
verses.37: His seed will live forever, and his throne will be like the sun, shining brightly in its place.
verses.38: May the fly be destroyed forever, and may it never be seen again in this world.
verses.39: And you have abandoned and neglected your Messiah.
verses.40: You have broken the covenant with your servant. You have desecrated the land of Nizro.
verses.41: You broke through all their barriers; you freed them from their captivity.
verses.42: All those who passed by that place were brought low by their surroundings.
verses.43: Raise him to the right side; rejoice over all his enemies.
verses.44: He did not even try to rebuild his ruined city, nor did he try to build it again after the war.
verses.45: It was set up as a place of worship and a sanctuary for the earth from its creation.
verses.46: You have shortened the days of his exile. You have burdened him with a heavy load.
verses.47: How long will Jehovah hide from us, and cause us to suffer like fire that burns fiercely?
verses.48: I remember what you created from clay. You created all human beings from it.
verses.49: Who can live and not fear death? Who can free their soul from the hands of Sheol?
verses.50: Oh, your early kindnesses, O Lord! You have blessed David with your truthfulness.
verses.51: Remember, O Lord, the disgrace of your servants. I have carried their suffering in my arms, along with all the nations.
verses.52: Those who have been humiliated by your enemies, O LORD! Those who have suffered because of your Messiah.
